journey.heading: From learning development to
paragraphs: I started with programming fundamentals and gradually moved into frontend and full-stack development.
Over time, I began building complete applications with authentication, APIs, databases, admin dashboards, deployment and real-time features.
Today my main focus is building structured MERN and backend-heavy products using React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL.
